T: Never give up. Never skip dessert.
D: A working-class kid from a steel town chases his dream of playing football for Notre Dame.
P: Serve the main when Rudy finally runs onto the field.
S: Rudy's shifts at the steel mill in Joliet

Thick slices of cold glazed meatloaf on toasted white bread with sharp cheddar, pickles and a smear of tomato relish. Mix 500g beef mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 tsp Worcestershire and salt. Press into a lined loaf tin, spread with 3 tbsp tomato sauce mixed with 1 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180C for 50 minutes. Cool completely and slice thickly. Toast 8 slices white bread. Fill with the meatloaf, 4 slices cheddar, pickles and tomato relish and cut in half.
game day tailgating at Notre Dame

Bratwurst simmered in lager and onions, then grilled until snappy, in toasted rolls with the beer onions and spicy brown mustard. Simmer 8 bratwurst in 375ml lager with 2 sliced onions and 20g butter for 15 minutes. Lift out the brats and grill for 6 minutes, turning, until charred. Keep boiling the onions until the liquid reduces and they turn sticky. Toast 8 rolls, fill with a brat and a pile of beer onions and finish with wholegrain mustard.
M: the Ruettiger family table in Joliet

Chuck roast braised low and slow with onions, carrots and potatoes in a rich gravy, served with horseradish cream and crusty bread. Season a 1.5kg chuck roast and brown all over in 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot. Add 2 quartered onions, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 500ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, thyme and 2 bay leaves. Cover and cook at 160C for 2 hours. Add 4 carrots and 800g halved potatoes and cook 1 hour more. Thicken the juices with 1 tbsp cornflour. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish cream.
W: Cinnamon apples under a crunchy pecan and oat crumble, baked bubbling and served with warm vanilla custard. Peel and slice 6 Granny Smith apples and toss with 60g caster sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and lemon juice. Tip into a baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 100g plain flour, then stir in 60g rolled oats, 80g brown sugar and 50g chopped pecans. Scatter over the apples and bake at 180C for 40 minutes until golden. Serve with 600ml warm custard.
K: the Golden Dome at Notre Dame on a cold autumn day

Cloudy apple juice warmed with cinnamon, cloves, orange and a little maple syrup, served steaming in mugs for a cold game day. Pour 1.2L cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 2 tbsp maple syrup, 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 1 star anise and 1 sliced orange. Heat gently for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and add a cinnamon stick and orange slice to each.
